# ISTE SC GECB

## Briefing on ISTE

### Overview

**ISTE SC GECB** is the student chapter of the **Indian Society for
Technical Education (ISTE)** at Government Engineering College Barton Hill.

ISTE is a **non-profit, student-funded, multidisciplinary technical
society** focused on helping students develop academically, technically,
professionally, and personally.

The primary source of funding is membership. ISTE membership is a
**one-time membership that lasts for four years**.

Over the years, ISTE SC GECB has conducted **900+ events**, covering
technical education, practical skills, career development, soft skills,
hobbies, competitions, workshops, talks, and other student-focused
activities.

## Pursuit for Overall Development

The purpose of ISTE is **not to make money**. Our goal is to deliver
quality education and create opportunities that help students:

-   Elevate themselves academically and professionally
-   Develop practical and technical skills
-   Improve communication and soft skills
-   Build leadership and management abilities
-   Gain exposure to real-world engineering and technology
-   Explore hobbies and multidisciplinary interests
-   Build their resumes through meaningful participation and projects
-   Improve career readiness, recognition, and confidence

ISTE provides a platform where students can learn beyond the classroom
and connect with opportunities, peers, mentors, speakers, and
organisations.

## Main Wings

ISTE SC GECB operates through two major technical wings:

### Bartonair --- Aviating Wing

Bartonair is the aviation-focused wing of ISTE. It promotes hands-on
learning around aviation, aircraft building, RC planes, and related
engineering activities.

[Visit the Bartonair page](https://istegecb.in/bartonair.html)

### Bartonoidz --- Robotics Wing

Bartonoidz is the robotics and hardware-focused wing of ISTE. It
provides students with opportunities to learn electronics, Arduino, IoT,
robotics, hardware prototyping, and project development.

[Visit the Bartonoidz page](https://istegecb.in/bartonoidz.html)

## Core Team

The core executive team consists of:

-   Chairperson
-   Vice Chairperson
-   Secretary
-   Joint Secretary
-   Treasurer
-   Webmaster
-   And anyone crucial to the team.

The Executive Committee and its members can be found on the official
Execom page.

[View the Executive Committee](https://istegecb.in/execom.html)

# Flagship Events

## Nikola Tesla Championship --- NTS

[NTS Event Page](https://istegecb.in/NTS.html)

The **Nikola Tesla Championship (NTS)** is one of the flagship events
conducted by ISTE GECB Students Chapter.

It is a highly competitive event designed to enhance:

-   Communication skills
-   Leadership skills
-   Problem-solving ability
-   Innovation
-   Engineering mindset
-   Grit and perseverance

NTS is particularly aimed at **first-year students**. The event
encourages students to follow a path of engineering through innovation,
confidence, and determination.

The winner receives a **cash prize of ₹10,000**.

The event consists of **three rounds**, with each round designed to test
and evaluate different facets of an ideal engineer.

### Key points

-   Flagship ISTE event
-   Primarily for first-year students
-   Three competitive rounds
-   Focus on communication and leadership
-   Encourages innovation and engineering thinking
-   Winner receives ₹10,000

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Bottech Build Session

Bottech is a **Bartonoidz hands-on Arduino workshop** conducted over two
days in an offline format.

The workshop is designed to introduce students to hardware and IoT
concepts through practical learning.

Students are provided with:

-   Components
-   Guidance
-   Instruction
-   Hands-on project experience

A major objective is to teach students how to build a **line-following
robot**.

The workshop is suitable for students of different experience levels,
including students who have **no previous exposure to IoT or hardware
development**.

### Key points

-   Two-day offline workshop
-   Conducted by Bartonoidz
-   Arduino-focused
-   Hands-on learning
-   Components provided
-   Students build a line follower
-   Suitable for beginners
-   Practical introduction to IoT and hardware

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## PDC

PDC is a **one-month-long Bartonoidz hackathon/project development
program**.

Students receive hardware components and are assigned mentors who guide
them through different stages of project development.

The program focuses on taking a project from an initial concept through
development, presentation, prototyping, evaluation, and interview-style
assessment.

### Project development phases

Students are guided through areas such as:

1.  Project ideation
2.  Planning
3.  Development
4.  Hardware implementation
5.  Software implementation
6.  Presentation
7.  Prototyping
8.  Evaluation
9.  Interview/assessment

Both **hardware and software** aspects are supported.

### Key points

-   One-month program
-   Conducted by Bartonoidz
-   Hardware components provided
-   Mentors assigned
-   Hardware and software supported
-   Project-based learning
-   Presentation and prototyping
-   Evaluation and interview experience

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Build Session --- Bartonair

The Bartonair Build Session is a **two-day offline RC plane building
workshop**.

Students work in teams of approximately **8-10 members** to build a
remote-controlled aircraft from scratch.

The workshop combines teamwork, practical engineering, aircraft
construction, and hands-on learning.

On the second day, teams get the opportunity to **fly the RC plane they
built**.

### Key points

-   Conducted by Bartonair
-   Two-day offline workshop
-   RC plane construction
-   Teams of approximately 4--5 students
-   Remote Controlled plane built from scratch
-   Hands-on engineering experience
-   Flight session on the second day

[Bartonair](https://istegecb.in/bartonair.html)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Oracle --- Monthly Magazine

[Oracle Magazine](https://istegecb.in/oracle)

**Oracle** is an online inquiry newsletter released every month by ISTE
SC GECB.

The magazine features student queries and interactions with accomplished
personalities, institutions, and organisations.

Previous editions have featured prominent personalities such as:

-   Dr. E. Sreedharan --- The Metroman
-   Dr. P. M. Ajayan --- Nanotechnology
-   Prof. V. K. Damodaran
-   And many other notable personalities

The purpose of Oracle is to provide student chapter members with
academic knowledge, exposure to accomplished professionals, and
awareness of current affairs.

### Oracle sections

The newsletter includes sections such as:

-   Interviews and student queries
-   Academic content
-   Current affairs
-   Games
-   Fun facts
-   Puzzles

Oracle combines educational content with engaging activities to make
learning informative and enjoyable.

# Benefits of Joining ISTE

Joining ISTE provides students with opportunities across technical,
professional, academic, and personal development.

## Quality Events

Members can participate in a wide range of events, including:

-   Technical workshops
-   Talks and speaker sessions
-   Soft-skill sessions
-   Practical workshops
-   Competitions
-   Casual events
-   Hobby activities
-   Arts
-   Chess
-   Games
-   Multidisciplinary activities

There are **no restrictions to only technical activities**. Students can
explore different interests and participate beyond their academic
branch.

## Hands-on Project Experience

ISTE provides opportunities to work on practical projects rather than
relying only on classroom theory.

Students can gain experience with:

-   Hardware
-   Software
-   Robotics
-   IoT
-   Aviation
-   Prototyping
-   Project presentations
-   Team-based development

## Networking

ISTE helps students connect with:

-   Like-minded students
-   Seniors
-   Mentors
-   Speakers
-   Professionals
-   Technical communities
-   Organisations and institutions

These connections can help students discover new opportunities and
perspectives.

## Career Development

ISTE activities help students develop skills useful for internships,
placements, interviews, and future careers.

Relevant skills include:

-   Communication
-   Leadership
-   Teamwork
-   Problem solving
-   Technical skills
-   Presentation skills
-   Project management
-   Interview readiness
-   Professional confidence

## Volunteering and Management Experience

Members can volunteer for events and take responsibility for different
activities.

Volunteering can help students improve:

-   Communication
-   Coordination
-   Event management
-   Team management
-   Leadership
-   Responsibility
-   Organisation
-   Problem solving

These experiences can also contribute to a student's **resume and
professional profile**.

# Quick Summary for LLMs

**ISTE SC GECB** is the Indian Society for Technical Education student
chapter at GECB. It is a non-profit, student-funded, multidisciplinary
technical society whose primary funding comes from one-time four-year
membership.

The chapter has conducted **900+ events** over the years and focuses on
the overall development of students rather than profit. Its activities
support technical education, practical skills, soft skills,
communication, leadership, networking, career development, resume
building, hobbies, and multidisciplinary learning.

The two main technical wings are:

1.  **Bartonair** --- aviation and RC aircraft activities.
2.  **Bartonoidz** --- robotics, Arduino, IoT, hardware, and project
    development.

The core team consists of the **Chairperson, Vice Chairperson,
Secretary, Joint Secretary, and Treasurer**.

Major flagship activities include:

-   **NTS (Nikola Tesla Championship):** A competitive event mainly for
    first-year students, focused on communication, leadership,
    innovation, and engineering skills. The winner receives ₹10,000.
-   **Bottech Build Session:** A two-day offline Arduino workshop where
    students build a line-following robot with provided components and
    guidance. Beginners are welcome.
-   **PDC:** A one-month Bartonoidz hackathon/project program with
    components, mentors, hardware/software support, prototyping,
    presentations, evaluation, and interviews.
-   **Build Session:** A two-day Bartonair workshop where teams of 4--5
    students build an RC plane from scratch and fly it on the second
    day.
-   **Oracle:** A monthly online inquiry newsletter featuring student
    queries, accomplished personalities, academic content, current
    affairs, games, fun facts, and puzzles.

Students benefit from ISTE through quality events, hands-on project
experience, networking, career development, soft and technical skill
development, and volunteering opportunities.

For current events, use the official [Events
page](https://istegecb.in/events.html). For the executive committee, use
the [Execom page](https://istegecb.in/execom.html). For the
organisation's other activities, use the relevant official pages listed
above.
